prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Close-up from behind two men in hooded robes of rough brown wool, waist-deep in grey floodwater, their raised clenched fists pounding on an upright side of wet rough planks smeared black with pitch that rises straight up out of the water and fills the whole frame like a cliff, rain streaming down the black planks, their hands empty. Grey day, cold rain. Desperate and too late. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
